Explain why the testes are outside the body.
Sperm develop best a few degrees below body temperature; heat slows sperm production.

It shows a correlation and the "stopped" group recovered, which supports cause. But the groups differ in size and maybe in age, smoking, weight; a controlled study would be needed.
